# harmoniq_manifest (Data Source)

The current (stable) manifest of an environment: which version of each module runs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "harmoniq_manifest" "production" {
  workspace   = "checkout-team"
  host_app    = "storefront"
  environment = "production"
}

output "checkout_version" {
  value = one([for m in data.harmoniq_manifest.production.modules : m.version if m.name == "checkout"])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment` (String) Environment slug.
- `host_app` (String) Host app slug.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace slug.

### Read-Only

- `etag` (String) Manifest ETag; changes with every change.
- `generated_at` (String) Time of the last change.
- `modules` (Attributes List) Modules in the manifest. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modules))

<a id="nestedatt--modules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `modules`

Read-Only:

- `disabled` (Boolean) Switched off by the kill switch.
- `integrity` (String) SRI hash.
- `name` (String) Module name.
- `url` (String) Remote entry URL.
- `version` (String) Active version.
